DCR_VAULT_ROOT.usage: External STRIX source-bundle files; resolve from the DCR vault root or P17_SOURCE_ROOT bundle root.

REPOSITORY_ROOT.usage: S-Structures implementation, evidence, archive, documentation and deliverables.

rules: Never join a DCR_VAULT_ROOT locator directly to REPOSITORY_ROOT.
P17_SOURCE_ROOT may relocate the physical bundle but must preserve the logical STRIX-verification-21 prefix in evidence.
All report and evidence artifact paths are REPOSITORY_ROOT-relative.
